text: And of this negotiation, let's go back to Wi-Fi. In Wi-Fi, we are then using this technique CSMA. On top of this technique, we have a mechanism called collision avoidance, which is different from what is used in Ethernet. Okay. We will discover what this collision avoidance is. Okay, so no worries, but it's a mechanism that allow nodes transmitters to avoid collisions. Okay. And the reason why in Wi-Fi they had to develop a new scheme, a new MAC scheme different from Ethernet, is because in Wi-Fi we have half duplex nodes. Remember, we stressed that very, we very much emphasis last time, our nodes are half duplex. So when they start transmitting, they will not be able to receive anything. So clearly, we cannot use this collision detection that is in Ethernet. They will not be able to detect that they are colliding. So what we need to do is try and avoid collisions, because once a collision takes place, then unfortunately we cannot stop it till the nodes stop transmitting.
